concept: S2N adds VPN functionality to a personal VPS; server slots and a routed network endpoint retain the existing blue identity.

assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: production desktop app icon for S2N Connect, a personal tool that adds VPN functionality to a user's own VPS. Create a single square 1024x1024 icon with genuinely transparent corners around a rounded-square royal-blue tile, preserving the existing product's blue-and-white visual identity. Inside the tile, create an original, very simple white server/network symbol: two broad horizontal server slots form a compact central server, and one continuous, bold, pale-cyan routed path curves from it to a single small circular network endpoint, suggesting a VPS becoming a connected private network. The silhouette should feel subtly like a flowing S, but semantic clarity and tiny-size legibility matter more than a literal letter. Crisp, vector-like geometry, flat or almost flat colors, generous optical padding, sophisticated balanced proportions; sufficiently heavy strokes to read at 16, 32 and 48 pixels. Tile royal blue around #2F6FED, white and very pale cyan mark. No letters, no numbers, no words, no lock, no shield, no globe, no busy circuits, no 3D bevel, no mockup, no extra variants, no watermark. The output is just one finished application icon, centered and filling most of the canvas.

assets.meaning: VPS → VPN expresses adding VPN functionality to an existing personal VPS; the direction arrows replace the former additive plus signs.
assets.prompt: Use case: text-localization. Asset type: existing S2N GitHub README title banner, exact targeted edit. Input image 1 is the edit target. Change only two plus symbols to right-pointing directional arrows. First, replace the large subtitle 'VPS + VPN' underneath the title with exact text 'VPS → VPN'; keep the same large bold dark-navy sans serif style, baseline, overall width and placement. The arrow must be a clear right-pointing arrow (→), with a horizontal shaft and arrowhead, so the meaning is adding VPN functionality to an existing VPS, not adding two products. Second, in the small white circular node on the right-hand cyan connection line, replace the small navy plus sign with a navy right-pointing arrow (→), centered. Keep the entire rest of the image unchanged: the blue rounded-square icon with white two-slot server and cyan routed path, exact S2N title, laptop, VPS server, routed connection, subtle blue grid, warm-white background, colors, clean geometry, all spacing, proportions, and the wide 2:1 composition. Exact visible text and only: 'S2N' and 'VPS → VPN'. Do not add any text, slogans, version, badges, advertising, locks, shields, or watermark. Preserve the original visual identity and typography. Produce one finished edited banner.

processing: Mechanical PNG resizing and multi-resolution ICO encoding preserve the generated design and transparency.
